1868.0: a leak in the airing cupboard, is it dripping from above or from the pipework?

1869.0: new shoes for the wedding, broken them in yet? new ones always rub on the day.

1870.0: the dog at the vet friday, just the jabs? ours hates the scales more than the needle.

1871.0: a wedding invite for december, far to travel? winter weddings always feel like more of an effort.

1872.0: the yearly boiler service is worth it. ours found a leak we'd have missed.

1873.0: next door's bonfire, did the smoke get you? ours drifts straight into the bedroom.

1874.0: the washing line snapped in the wind? a new one is a fiver, get the thicker cord.

1875.0: the new cafe, been in yet? i give them a month before the queues die down.

1876.0: the coat zip jammed, rub a pencil along the teeth. old trick but it does work.

1877.0: four new tyres on the car is a chunk of money. worth it before winter though.

1878.0: the school play next week, going to it? the nativity is always the best bit.

1879.0: a half marathon, well done. how's the training going? the long runs are the ones that count.

1880.0: the printer packed up again, they always pick the worst moment. worth a new one?

1881.0: a bird feeder in the tree, getting much on it yet? takes them a week to find it.

1882.0: the pen leaking all over the bag, ink everywhere? that never comes out of a lining.

1883.0: a long muddy walk on sunday, wellies or boots? boots are the only thing for that clay.

1884.0: a slow cooker, nice. what have you done in it? stews are the obvious one, porridge too.

1885.0: a mouse in the shed, just the one or a family? they never seem to come alone.

1886.0: the wheelie bin lid coming off, does the council replace those?
1886.1: ring them then. stick a brick on top of the bin lid till it's sorted.

1887.0: his first driving lesson, did he enjoy it? they either love it or hate it.
1887.1: stalling ten times is normal. we all did. the clutch is the hard bit at the start.

1888.0: the wellies splitting at the heel, annoying. the heel always goes at the worst time.
1888.1: right at the seam, of course. glue holds them for a while, but they always go again.

1889.0: the village fete on saturday, are you helping out again?

1890.0: a bread maker, exciting. what's the first loaf going to be?
1890.1: start simple with the white, then try the sourdough. that is where it gets serious.

1891.0: the kitchen sink draining slowly, is it the trap?
1891.1: weeks of slow draining, soda crystals and hot water clear it. cheaper than a plumber.

1892.0: lost one of the gloves, the good ones or the spare pair?

1893.0: the parcel never turning up, chase it up with the courier?
1893.1: they said it was delivered, that's the worst answer. ask for the photo proof and it usually appears.

1894.0: a new coat, what colour did you go for?
1894.1: dark green is a good change. it goes with most things and hides a bit of wear.

1895.0: the hall bulb has gone, have you got spares in the cupboard?
1895.1: pick some up then, get the long life ones. you'll not want to be up that ladder again.

1896.0: the shed window is cracked, how did that happen? any idea when?
1896.1: a branch maybe, tape holds it for now. a glazier is cheap enough for a small pane.

1897.0: a spider living in the porch, is it a harmless one at least?
1897.1: the size of your hand, right. leave it be, they eat the flies and don't bother you.

1898.0: the long drive up north, was it a long one? what is it, five hours?
1898.1: seven hours with the stops is a proper haul. the last hour is always the worst.

1899.0: a new barber, does he do a proper job?
1899.1: the best cut in years, hold onto him. a good barber is worth the wait.

1900.0: a takeaway curry last night, was it a good one?
1900.1: the best round here, that's your new place then. worth keeping the menu handy.

1901.0: the lawnmower won't start, old fuel probably. has it been sat long?
1901.1: sat all summer, that is it then. drain it and put fresh in, it'll fire up.

1902.0: your birthday on monday, have you got anything planned?

1903.0: the holiday let double booked, have you asked the owner to sort it?
